title: Trees embed in graphs of large minimum degree
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph and let $T$ be a tree on $m$ vertices. If every vertex of $G$ has degree at least $m-1$, so that the minimum degree satisfies $\delta(G) \ge m-1$, then $G$ contains a copy of $T$; that is, there is an injective map from the vertices of $T$ into those of $G$ that sends every edge of $T$ to an edge of $G$, exhibiting $T$ as a subgraph of $G$.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
the vertex set of T has cardinality m
the minimum degree of G is at least m - 1
